This section has no case status table. The moves below are instruction status moves on `LOV-INSTR-STATUS`, not values of LOV-CASE-STATUS, and S9 rwb-partner makes them:

- SENT to IN_PROGRESS on `PartnerResultSubmitted` on `rwb.partner.events.v1`, when the partner records the result on the portal.
- IN_PROGRESS to DONE on `PartnerResultSubmitted` on `rwb.partner.events.v1`, when the result is the final one for the instruction.
- SENT to RECALLED on PARTNER_NO_RESPONSE, when the service level is missed and the chase has run once (R-UNI-25).
- SENT to RECALLED on PARTNER_CONFLICT_DECLARED, when the partner declares a conflict (R-UNI-27).
- Any active instruction status to RECALLED on PARTNER_PANEL_EXIT, when the partner leaves the panel or the contract ends (R-UNI-26).
- Any active instruction status to RECALLED on PARTNER_CONDUCT_BREACH, when a conduct or complaint breach is upheld (R-UNI-29).
